patches.title: Three Empties Switch
patches.principle: After opening three containers of the same type and finding them empty, switch to a different location type like open surfaces or drawers.
patches.when_to_apply: When three consecutive identical container opens yield nothing.

patches.title: Fridge First for Food
patches.principle: When cleaning food items, begin search by going to the fridge before exploring other containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning a food item (egg, pan, etc.).
